chunks: Abu Ja'far عليه السلام offered the funeral prayer over a young little son of his who was three years old.
Then he said: "Were it not that people would say that Banu Hashim do not offer the funeral prayer over their small children, I would not have prayed over him."

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muhammad ibn 'Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام offer salat al-janazah for a young child?
ai.summary: This report narrates that Imam Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام offered the funeral prayer over his three-year-old son. He then explained that his doing so was to prevent people from claiming that Banu Hashim do not pray over their young children, showing a concern for public religious practice and perception.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.487 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) offered the funeral prayer for a young son of his who was three years old.
He then said: "If it were not for the fact that people might say that the Banu Hashim do not offer funeral prayers for their young children, I would not have prayed over him”.
